The two plugins never call each other

They share two objects, each named twice. Install both and you point each pair at the same place — that is the whole of the configuration. One more thing crosses as data: the version a handover is pinned to, which the ticket then cites.
pm
task-draft
the context table — what was asked, by whom, and what nobody has decided
→
pm
prd
the spec — what has to be true once this is built
→
fig
prep · draw · arrows · lint · handoff
draw it, audit it, hand it over pinned to a version
→
pm
task-publish
the ticket engineering picks up
→
fig
qa · sync
judge what shipped against that same spec, then bring canonical current

Two objects, two names each

Leave either unset and the skill still runs — you lose the linkage, not the skill.
the objectfig calls itpm calls itwhat you lose
the requirements docqa.baseline.prdprd.target a defect report with no rule to cite
the task recordtask_tracker.reftask.record.ref a comparison table with nowhere to go
Neither plugin needs the other. Install fig alone and it audits design files. Install pm alone and it writes specs and files tasks. The pairing is what makes a defect say this breaks rule X in document Y.
